course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Same request, new state: from draft to saved record
goal: Create and write an own request, then update the same document while checking reference, duration and status.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P4. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: You edited a request, but reopening still shows the old minutes. Did the change stop in memory, during saving, or afterwards? Follow one reference from an unsaved draft to a second fresh read.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Documents have state
paragraphs: A new object exists in memory before its first write. A written document has persisted fields and identity. A posted document additionally passed its configured accounting processing. Deletion marking is not physical deletion. Define commands and invariants for each state rather than treating UI as the lifecycle model.

The full function creates its own customer/service and a new request object. Its reference is empty before writing. Filling fields and calling Записать persists a 30-minute Новая request. Rereading through the reference tests database state; the current variable value alone does not.

sections.title: Prepare the experiment while retaining P4
paragraphs: Continue your own P4 copy after preserving its DT and sources. Do not load a full configuration over prior work. If using the supplied training template, load service-desk-documents-v2 into a new separate infobase and distinguish it from your continuing work.

ЗаявкаУслуги needs Клиент, Услуга, Статус, ДлительностьМинут and Комментарий. ПередЗаписью must refuse missing customer/service/status and minutes outside 0…1440. Review the existing handler first; do not create another procedure of the same name.
Keep the existing УчебныеДанные common module. Append the new function outside existing definitions; the application calls it once. Posting is not required for these observations.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: First create a 30-minute request in status Новая. Saving gives it a reference. Retrieve an object through that same reference, set 60 and ВРаботе, save, and read again. The three labelled Да values concern different stages; the last does not imply automatic posting.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: A number does not replace identity
paragraphs: Numbers serve people, but numbering scope and periodicity depend on configuration. Use references for exact reopening. Two similar requests are not automatically duplicates. External request IDs need an explicit uniqueness policy; displayed document numbers alone are not a redelivery strategy.

Next obtain the same document object, set 60 minutes and ВРаботе, then write again. The assertion compares reference, duration and status. Creating another document would produce a second request, not an update. Record the assigned number and use it when inspecting the list.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Does saving status Закрыта automatically post the document?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. In this configuration an enumeration assignment changes a field, and ordinary Записать saves fields. Posting is requested through a separate mode; check its flag and movements separately.

sections.title: Verify accounting effects separately
paragraphs: Posting may be unavailable in a starter configuration. EvenPosted=True does not specify required register records. Define business meaning and affected registers first, then link states to expected records. Document reports and movement reports answer different questions.

ВРаботе is an application enumeration value. Проведен is a separate posting flag associated with register movements. This experiment uses an ordinary write, so it remains unposted. Selecting a status does not by itself schedule work, grant access or implement a transition rule; those need explicit code.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram follows the worked example.30 and 60 are states of one document, not two requests. The reference obtained by the first save connects both fresh reads.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Calling СоздатьДокумент instead of retrieving the saved reference creates another request. Its 75 minutes may be correct, but the old request was not updated. The minutes assertion passes while reference equality fails.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Test through a new session
paragraphs: Create, write without posting and reread. Then post in a suitable template, check movements and reverse posting. Reopen a session and compare states and identities. Name the exact configuration: posting results do not retroactively prove the earlyA2/P 2 stand supports posting.

The incorrect variant changes the second duration assignment from 60 to 61. It compiles and preserves the reference but fails the duration assertion. This distinguishes a semantic check from merely running without exceptions. Each run creates new synthetic items: remove the startup call afterward while preserving the function and observation.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create a new 45-minute request in Новая. Update that same request to 75 minutes and Закрыта. Freshly read it and verify the same reference, customer and service, 75 minutes, Закрыта status, and absence of posting.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain why Закрыта does not establish posting and why a new СоздатьДокумент does not update the earlier request.
